The issuer shows only modest liquidity (current ratio 1.04), while leverage is high (equity of 18,677M versus total liabilities of 111,269M; equity is a small share of assets). At the same time, profitability appears solid (EBIT of 2,359M on revenue of 12,717M). Overall, the balance-sheet risk outweighs the operating strength, placing the credit in the lower-to-high speculative range.  

DECISION: BB+
